svg.title: Neoptolemos killing Priam, who sits on the altar with the dead Astyanax across his knees
svg.desc: Line drawing after Karl Reichhold's drawing of the Vivenzio hydria by the Kleophrades Painter (Naples), in Furtwängler and Reichhold, Griechische Vasenmalerei I (1904), Taf. 34; cut out and retraced.
